title: Vampire Vape Shortz Cool Blue Slush
description: A nostalgic fruit blast uncannily reminiscent of those refreshing Blue Slushies we enjoyed as kids, this exquisite e-liquid from Vampire Vape’s Shortz collection balances rich, sweet Blueberries and ripe, tangy Raspberries with a refreshing icy exhale. Practically the definition of an all-day vape. These shortfill bottles contain 50ml of nicotine-free liquid, with 10ml of extra space within the bottle to accommodate your nicotine shot of choice. This allows you to create a liquid with your own desired nicotine strength. Typically, adding a 10ml nicotine shot to a 50ml shortfill will give you 60ml of 3mg e-liquid. Once you have added your preferred amount of nicotine, make sure to shake the contents of the shortfill bottle well.
